name: Manish Jain

about: Builds Learn Like Magic end to end: the learning app for Indian school students (backend, frontend, admin, iOS) and the content factories that turn school textbooks into app content.

repos.what: The Learn Like Magic product: llm-backend, llm-frontend, llm-admin, the iOS app, and the in-repo content factory. Feature trackers live in docs/feature-development/<feature>/STATE.md.
Runs the content factories on Codex through an adapter; Manish's standing decisions in DECISIONS.md.
The content factories as an explicit, model-neutral pipeline (LangGraph, Python): textbook to app content.
Codex-native execution harnesses for the content factories (Practice, Guideline, TOC, Revise).
